login.tagline: Manage rentals, assets, and customers in one place.
login.errorGeneric: We couldn't sign you in. Try again.

twoFactor.title: Verify your identity
twoFactor.subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
twoFactor.resendSuccess: We sent you a new code. The previous one no longer works.
twoFactor.errorGeneric: We couldn't verify the code. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Recover password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset it.
forgotPassword.successMessage: If an account with that email exists, we sent a link to reset your password.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter your new password.
resetPassword.toastSuccess: Password updated. You can sign in now.
resetPassword.errorGeneric: We couldn't reset your password. The link may have expired.
resetPassword.missingToken: The recovery link is invalid. Request a new one.

forcedChangePassword.title: Change your password
forcedChangePassword.subtitle: You have a temporary password pending change.
forcedChangePassword.subtitleWithName: Hi {{name}}, you have a temporary password pending change.
forcedChangePassword.errorGeneric: We couldn't update the password. Try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Register your rental business on Alkiman.
register.errorEmailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
register.errorGeneric: We couldn't complete your registration. Try again.
